Description: Delegate real work to Copilot, such as creating or updating records or running actions in Business Central.

FeatureName: Add subcontracting suggestions to an existing purchase order
Description: In the Subcontracting app, open Subcontracting Worksheets. On a new suggestion, choose Assign purchase order and select a compatible open order for the vendor. Accept the suggestion and run Carry Out Action Message, then check the selected order for the new line.
